Simplify modeling complexity with ['简化藤编纹理的细节层次', '统一椅腿的圆柱造型']: use clean broad surfaces, shallow orderly folds, separated non-intersecting parts, and avoid tangled fabric or dense tiny wrinkles. Complete occluded, back, side and underside regions using {'type': 'bilateral', 'completionRule': '沿靠背竖直中线对称补全左右结构'} and ['补全被边几遮挡的前侧椅腿', '补全座面遮挡区域']. Preserve the corresponding width-to-depth-to-height proportions. These are category-prior estimates rather than pixel measurements. Use conservative category structure, repeated modules, continuous closed geometry, and one 45-degree product view on a plain light background. Keep only the main object.
